panel_source: FLI AI Safety Index Winter 2025 — Independent Review Panel

reviewers.name: Stuart Russell
institutional_affiliations: Professor of Computer Science, UC Berkeley
Director, Center for Human-Compatible AI (CHAI), UC Berkeley
Director, Kavli Center for Ethics, Science, and the Public
reviewers.notes: Confirmed panel member per FLI Winter 2025 Independent Review Panel section (https://futureoflife.org/ai-safety-index-winter-2025/). Member, National Academy of Engineering; Fellow of the Royal Society; OBE 2021; coauthor of the standard AI textbook used in 1500+ universities. Quoted in the report: 'AI CEOs claim they know how to build superhuman AI, yet none can show how they'll prevent us from losing control' — addressing existential safety.

reviewers.name: David Krueger
institutional_affiliations: Assistant Professor in Robust, Reasoning and Responsible AI, Department of Computer Science and Operations Research (DIRO), University of Montreal
Core Academic Member, Mila
Affiliated researcher, UC Berkeley Center for Human Compatible AI
Affiliated researcher, Centre for the Study of Existential Risk
reviewers.notes: Confirmed panel member per FLI Winter 2025 panel. Work focuses on reducing the risk of human extinction from AI. Domain assignments derived from his existential-risk focus.

reviewers.name: Dylan Hadfield-Menell
institutional_affiliations: Assistant Professor, MIT CSAIL
Lead, Algorithmic Alignment Group, MIT CSAIL
Schmidt Sciences AI2050 Early Career Fellow
reviewers.notes: Confirmed panel member per FLI Winter 2025 panel. Research on safe and trustworthy AI deployment with emphasis on multi-agent systems, human-AI teams, societal oversight of ML. DEPARTED the panel for Summer 2026.

reviewers.name: Jessica Newman
institutional_affiliations: Founding Director, AI Security Initiative, Center for Long-Term Cybersecurity, UC Berkeley
Expert, OECD Expert Group on AI Risk and Accountability
Contributor, U.S. Center for AI Standards and Innovation working groups
Contributor, EU Code of Practice Plenaries
reviewers.notes: Confirmed panel member per FLI Winter 2025 panel. Domain assignments derived from her governance / standards-body remit. DEPARTED the panel for Summer 2026.

reviewers.name: Sneha Revanur
institutional_affiliations: Founder and President, Encode (youth-led AI accountability organization)
reviewers.notes: Confirmed panel member per FLI Winter 2025 panel. Featured on TIME's inaugural list of 100 most influential people in AI.

reviewers.name: Sharon Li
institutional_affiliations: Associate Professor, Department of Computer Sciences, University of Wisconsin-Madison
reviewers.notes: Confirmed panel member per FLI Winter 2025 panel. Program Chair for ICML 2026; Sloan Fellowship (2025), NSF CAREER Award (2023), MIT Innovators Under 35 (2023), Forbes 30under30 in Science (2020), Outstanding Paper Award at NeurIPS 2022 and ICLR 2022.

reviewers.name: Tegan Maharaj
institutional_affiliations: Assistant Professor, Department of Decision Sciences, HEC Montréal
Lead, ERRATA lab on Ecological Risk and Responsible AI
Core academic member, Mila
reviewers.notes: Confirmed panel member per FLI Winter 2025 panel. Quoted in the report on 'ChatGPT-related incidents' under Current Harms. Previously Assistant Professor of Machine Learning at the University of Toronto.

reviewers.name: Yi Zeng
institutional_affiliations: AI Professor, Chinese Academy of Sciences
Founding Dean, Beijing Institute of AI Safety and Governance
Director, Beijing Key Laboratory of Safe AI and Superalignment
reviewers.notes: Confirmed panel member per FLI Winter 2025 panel. Serves on the UN High-level Advisory Body on AI, UNESCO Ad Hoc Expert Group on AI Ethics, WHO Expert Group on the Ethics/Governance of AI for Health, and the National Governance Committee of Next Generation AI in China. TIME100 AI list. The only panel member affiliated with a Chinese institution in both cycles.

note: All eight names are taken verbatim from the published FLI Winter 2025 Independent Review Panel section (https://futureoflife.org/ai-safety-index-winter-2025/) and cross-confirmed against the FLI Winter 2025 2-pager (https://futureoflife.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/AI-Safety-Index-Report_011225_TwoPager_Digital.pdf). Domain assignments are derived judgments from each reviewer's published research focus; FLI does not publicly disclose which reviewer graded which domain.
